gdpr.subtitle: Nos comprometemos a proteger tus datos personales de acuerdo con el Reglamento General de Protección de Datos de la UE.

gdpr.commitmentBody: CyberSec Pro is fully committed to GDPR compliance. We respect your privacy and give you full control over your personal data. As an EU-focused platform, data protection is at the core of everything we do.

access.title: Right of Access (Art. 15)
access.desc: You can request a complete copy of all personal data we hold about you.

rectification.title: Right to Rectification (Art. 16)
rectification.desc: You can correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal data in your account settings.

erasure.title: Right to Erasure (Art. 17)
erasure.desc: You can request complete deletion of your account and all associated data.

restriction.title: Right to Restriction (Art. 18)
restriction.desc: You can request that we restrict processing of your data while a dispute is resolved.

portability.title: Right to Data Portability (Art. 20)
portability.desc: You can receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON).

object.title: Right to Object (Art. 21)
object.desc: You can object to processing of your data for direct marketing purposes.

gdpr.signInPrompt: to exercise your data rights directly from this page, or contact us at
gdpr.dpaIntro: For enterprise customers, we provide a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) in compliance with Art. 28 GDPR. Our DPA covers:

gdpr.dpoIntro: For GDPR-related inquiries, contact our DPO:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: CyberSec Pro ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (EU) 2016/679.
privacy.section2Body: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:

section3.usageItem1: Scan targets and results (encrypted at rest)

privacy.section4Body: We process your data under the following legal bases (Art. 6 GDPR):
privacy.section5Body: As an EU/EEA resident, you have the following rights:

section6.item1: Account data: Retained while your account is active + 30 days after deletion
section6.item2: Scan results: Retained for 90 days, then automatically purged
section6.item3: Access logs: Retained for 12 months for security purposes
section6.item4: Payment records: Retained as required by tax law (typically 7 years)

privacy.section7Body: Your data is processed within the European Union. If data must be transferred outside the EU/EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place (Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions per Art. 46 GDPR).
privacy.section9Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including:

section9.item1: TLS 1.3 encryption for all data in transit
section9.item2: AES-256 encryption for data at rest
section9.item3: Regular security audits and penetration testing

privacy.section10Body: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in the EU Member State of your habitual residence, place of work, or place of the alleged infringement.
privacy.section11Body: For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your data rights:

section11.responseTime: Response time: Within 30 days (as required by GDPR Art. 12)

register.ransomwareBody: A ransomware attack hits a business every 11 seconds. Average ransom payments have exceeded $1.5 million.
register.humanFactorBody: 68% of breaches involve a non-malicious human element — phishing, misconfigurations, and weak credentials.

register.quote: The question is not whether you will be breached, but when. The only defense is preparation.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: By accessing or using CyberSec Pro ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
terms.section2Body: CyberSec Pro provides a cloud-based penetration testing platform with access to security tools for authorized testing purposes. The Service includes:

section2.item1: Access to 401 Kali Linux security tools via web interface
section2.item4: Remote agent management for distributed testing

section3.item1: Have explicit written authorization before scanning any target
section3.item2: Only scan systems you own or have permission to test
section3.item3: Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
section3.item4: Not use the Service for any malicious, illegal, or unauthorized purpose
section3.item5: Not attempt to disrupt the Service or other users' operations

section4.item1: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials
section4.item2: You must provide accurate and complete registration information
section4.item3: You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account
section4.item4: You are responsible for all activities conducted under your account

section5.item1: All prices are displayed in Euros (€) and exclude applicable VAT
section5.item2: Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually, depending on your selection
section5.item3: Payments are processed securely via Stripe
section5.item4: You may cancel your subscription at any time; access continues until the end of the billing period
section5.item5: Refunds are available within 30 days of initial purchase

terms.section7Body: The CyberSec Pro platform, including its design, code, and documentation, is the intellectual property of Semih Kılıç. The security tools available through the platform are open-source and distributed under their respective licenses.
terms.section8Body: CyberSec Pro is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use or inability to use the Service, including but not limited to damages caused by scan results, tool outputs, or service interruptions.
terms.section9Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the European Union and the applicable national law. Any disputes shall be resolved in the competent courts of the European Union.
